test_title: PYST 19: SSC CHSL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 05 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Identify the figure given in the options that when put in place of the question mark (?) will logically complete the series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/74f309718cd64e4aa6bbdca8dd4fa79fb84c37df9e1fab7ee80f32dbfe8e9998.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is :

1) First box alternate series → Elements shift in the downward clockwise direction diagonally.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/07cb7bcc218833a0675e27b349866314ce6beaf342567054a2c0fcaa16c5f35e.png] 

2) Second box alternate series → Elements shift in the anticlockwise direction at the corners and the center element is replaced by new element.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ea6372f5b5437f87fb0acfc5b122ea1e99fb1c965aea22cfd845a680c4363cab.png] 

Thus, the final series is :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a02ddd72d66d59629715f37ef463b5751407e8e0ecb02139a290ec470f5096bb.png] 

Hence, "Option - (2)" is the correct answer.
